title: Gate one sparse-attention decode leaf across paged-KV contexts
objective: Determine whether one DSA sparse-attention leaf candidate wins without regression across the traced logical KV-length distribution.
steps: Run serving_native/context_matrix.py with the named profile and candidate
Measure fixed and ragged M16/M32 scenarios with their true seq_lens, FP8 cache, page size, and top-k
Inspect every eager and graph paired result
Persist matrix.json and all scenario logs

acceptance.pass: Every traced sparse-attention scenario passes correctness and the paired eager+graph leaf gate; full decode remains unproven.
acceptance.no_win: Any stable production scenario misses the speed gate or regresses.
acceptance.invalid: The profile is diagnostic, stale, or not trace-backed.

stop_rule: A win at context=8192 alone, or a sparse-attention win without full-context indexer/top-k region timing, cannot be promoted.
origin_evidence: The earlier serving-native DSA decode contract exercised only context=8192.
